findings.title: Accessibility and hosting questions land on a general page
findings.evidence: “accessibility support” (37) and “hosting” (29) are the top site searches. Both lead to Services, which covers each in a short paragraph.
findings.recommendation: Give each its own section on Services, with a clear next step such as a contact link.

findings.title: Pricing questions have no direct answer
findings.evidence: “pricing” was searched 18 times. None of the 10 most visited pages explain cost or how quotes work.
findings.recommendation: Add a short explanation of how SWS scopes and prices work, or where to ask.
